notes.text: You can now use value help with parameterized entity sets
You can now disable the selection of leaf nodes in tree tables
We've resolved an issue where the UI.Hidden annotation was ignored in phone and email entries in the contact quick view
You can now suppress the thousands separator for integer fields using the formatOptions settings in the manifest.json file
We now support semantic date operators in a parameterized service
You can now override the inputFormat of date fields for data exports from the Table building block
We've resolved an issue where pasting data from the clipboard into a table caused columns to incorrectly shift when a measure field referenced a virtual unit of measure
We now correctly handle table sorting when variantManagement is set to None
You can now use the sourceControl parameter from the adaptNavigationContext hook to identify which control triggered intent-based navigation
We’ve resolved an issue where analytical tables failed to load when UpdateRestrictions pointed to a navigation property
We now correctly sort an amount column when there are multiple currencies
We've resolved an issue when pasting data into a date range field in a table by ensuring the field supports EditableDisplay
